newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortel to hire 5,000 in C$250 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nortel to hire 5,000 in C$250 mln expansion.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd, one of Canada's largest telecommunications firms, said on Friday that it will hire 5,000 workers over the next four years in a C$250 million business expansion in the Ottawa region.

Nortel, a unit of BCE Inc, currently employs 10,000 people, mostly in the research and development area, in Canada's capital region and ships its telephone networking products and expertise around the world.
"Our growth in Canada is a direct result of our success internationally," said president and chief operating officer John Roth.
To accommodate the new workers, Nortel also plans to expand its facilities in the region with more buildings and renovations worth C$250 million, it said.
The expansion will include a C$160 million investment in new product development facilities to be added to its site in Carling, a suburb of Ottawa.
Most of the recruits will be skilled in computer science, software development, electrical enegineering and other technology specialties.
Nortel, which posted 1996 yearly revenues of US$12.8 bilion, has already 68,000 employees around the world.
